Consider the diagram shown above, where QT→=a, RS→=b, TR→=c, and RP→=d. Find QP→ in terms of a,b,c, and d.

a
QP→=b+c+d
b
QP→=a+c+d
c
QP→=b+c−d
d
QP→=b−a+c
e
QP→=a−b+d
